column1: # hypothesis: Repairing the air sublevel set's connectivity after a brush dig costs work proportional to the DIRTY SET and not to the lattice. Concretely: at a fixed brush radius
column2: the number of union operations an incremental insertion-only update performs is constant as the lattice grows through 33
column4: so unions divided by newly-air samples stays inside a narrow band and never exceeds 6 -- the degree of the lattice -- while a full rebuild's union count grows as n cubed. Digging only ever inserts
column5: and an insert joins at most two trees with no replacement-edge search
column6: so a union-find is the entire structure.

column1: # falsified by: The incremental union count growing with n cubed at a fixed brush size. That is R-022's own stated falsifier and it would mean edit-proportional repair is unavailable even in the easy direction
column2: which closes the whole direction rather than only this half. Separately falsified by unions per dirty sample exceeding 6
column3: which would mean the harness is visiting something other than the six incident lattice edges and is measuring its own traversal rather than the repair.
